subject: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Hi Shannon,

Hope all is well with you.

My name is Amin from Avicenna. I actually reached out to Dr. Murray back in March about helping with your ADAPT study, and I’m happy that we can now support your project.

In general, our patient-centric research tool makes it easy to collect different types of data from participants, process and visualize it, and even trigger customized interventions, all in one place.

I’d love to hop on a quick call to walk you through it and learn more about your project but I’ll be traveling for business for the next two weeks with a pretty unpredictable schedule. I'll be back in the office on October 23rd and can meet whenever works best for you. I’ve shared my calendar here. 

If timing is tight on your end, let me know, and I’ll do my best to find a time next week.

Best,
Amin
--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com
--

subject: Re: Welcome to Avicenna
body:
Hi Amin,
 
Thanks so much for getting back to us and I'm glad to hear that you've reached out before to offer support for ADAPT!
 
Just to highlight a question from when I filled out the contact form – would you be able to briefly share whether Avicenna could deliver a mobile JITAI/MRT? Again, we would be co-developing intervention messages for a mobile JITAI for young adults and piloting the mobile JITAI using a 28-day micro-randomized trial. If so, we'd love to learn more and @Murray, Caitlin can share more details about our project in the meeting.
 
Thanks,
 

Shannon Hong
